# General Contractors in Orlando

## Superior Roofing, Remodeling & Construction Services for Orlando-Area Homes & Businesses

[Wolfpack Construction](https://www.wolfpackfl.com/about-us/) is proud to be a family-owned and operated general contracting company providing the finest roofing, construction, and remodeling services to homes and businesses in the Orlando area.

As a **Certified General Contractor in the State of Florida**(license # CGC1531295) and a **Top 20 Contractor for Home Depot**, we are known for our unyielding commitment to high-quality craftsmanship.

Whatever your needs may be, from roofing, [home remodel](https://www.wolfpackfl.com/residential-construction/remodeling/) to a [commercial construction](https://www.wolfpackfl.com/commercial-construction/) project, we are prepared to complete your project on time and within budget.

We get the job done right the first time, using the highest-quality materials and a work ethic that’s been passed down through our family for generations.

**When you need a general contractor in Orlando, you need Wolfpack Construction. Call** [**(407) 449-8228**](tel:(407) 449-8228) **to get started with a free estimate.**

## Reliable General Contractors in Orlando, Florida

Finding reliable contractors can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to large and complex projects like new construction or remodeling. At Wolfpack Construction, our general contractors are **highly skilled and experienced professionals** who know the ins and outs of the construction industry.

Whether you need help with a [residential construction](https://www.wolfpackfl.com/residential-construction/), commercial construction, professional, or anything in between, our Orlando experts will work hard to get the job done right.

With our expert guidance and support, you can rest easy knowing that your project is in good hands. So if you're looking for building contractors in Orlando,contact Wolfpack Construction! We're ready to help you every step of the way.

**Trust Wolfpack Construction to bring your vision to life. Call our Orlando office at** [**(407) 449-8228**](tel:(407) 449-8228) **or** [**send us a message online today**](https://www.wolfpackfl.com/contact-us/) **to schedule your consultation!**

#### Why Wolfpack?

- **Results-Driven**



We take initiative, move fast, and follow through so your project keeps progressing.

- **Humbly Confident**


You get experienced guidance: we listen, collaborate, and make smart decisions.


- **We Treat Everyone Like Family**


We lead with respect, kindness, and care for your home, business, and everyone involved.


- **Professional**


Competent team, clean presentation, accountable work, and strong communication every step of the way.

- **Transparent Communication**


Clear updates, honest answers, and full context so you always know what’s happening and why.

### Managing your privacy preferences

We use cookies and scripts to improve site performance, understand
how you use our site, and deliver relevant content and advertising.
You can choose which types of cookies to allow. Essential cookies
are necessary for the site to function and cannot be turned off.


#### Manage Your Consent Preferences

Essential Cookies

Always Active


These cookies are required for core website functions,
such as secure login, privacy opt-outs, page navigation,
and submitting forms, and cannot be turned off.


Analytics Cookies

Toggle analytics cookies


These cookies help us understand how visitors use our site
so we can measure and improve performance. They tell us
which pages are popular, how long people stay, and how they
navigate the site. This allows us to make improvements for
our visitors.


Marketing Cookies

Toggle marketing cookies


These cookies are used to personalize the advertising you
see and may involve sharing information with our
advertising partners.

Turning this category off - or choosing
